about.title: About us
about.description: Openroute is a Moscow-based travel agency. We plan trips worldwide and support travellers 24/7.
story: Openroute started with a simple idea: planning a holiday should be as easy as ordering a taxi. No endless browser tabs, no comparing hundreds of hotels, no fear that something will go wrong.
Today we put together beach, sightseeing and ski tours, as well as tailor-made trips — from a honeymoon in the Maldives to a family northern-lights trip to Murmansk.
We combine experienced human managers with an AI assistant that answers travellers' questions around the clock.
